_about: Silhouette geometry for the four new/revised kin proposed in design_handoff_kin_tab. Coordinate space is identical to design/canvas/mascot-paths.json — a 1000 x 897 box, which is the slime's character bounding box (aspect 1.1145). Normalise by dividing x by 1000 and y by 897 to match SlimeArt's unit space.
_draw_order: Draw shapes in array order: mitten bulges first (behind), then torso, then the signature feature, then the belly patch, then the face. All body-coloured shapes use the SAME fill with NO stroke, which is what makes the overlapping primitives read as one continuous silhouette. Never add an outline.
_face: Faces are NOT new art. Apply the existing SlimeArt.faceIdle / faceDeadpan / faceJudging / faceDelight / faceSleep paths under the transform given per species: translate(cx,cy) scale(s) translate(-494,-388). 494,388 is the centre of the traced face bbox in this coordinate space.
_belly: Belly fill is the existing Slime.belly(for:) blend — 57% toward white from the body colour. Values below are that blend precomputed. Belly width is 34-36% of total silhouette width in every species, matching the approved slime.

slime.status: SHIPPING ART — do not modify. Listed for comparison only.

ember.readsAs: The narrowest kin in the set. A tall column with straight sides and a small seat.
ember.signature: One vertical flame tip curling back to the right, 205 units tall
ember._fix: Mitten lobes moved in and widened (cx 232->268, rx 58->74). At the old values the lobe ended at x=290 and the torso began at x=300 — a 10-unit gap, so the arms rendered as detached buttons.

droplet.readsAs: The widest and lowest-sitting kin. Half again as wide as it is tall.
droplet.signature: No spike at all — three round ripple bumps across the crown

sprout.readsAs: An egg — widest above the middle, tapering to a narrow seat.
sprout.signature: Two pointed leaves forking off the crown in a V

wisp.readsAs: The only kin without a flat bottom. Its base breaks into three deep lobes that hang well below the mitten bulges, so it reads as hovering.
wisp.signature: A wide low cap flaring out past the body, like a mushroom. It is part of the torso path, not a shape laid over it, so there is no join to see. The body narrows under the cap and breaks into three hanging lobes.

blush.note: Level 2 blush needs repositioning for this species — the shared #blush geometry sits too wide.

wisp._fix: Hood replaced by a cap folded into the torso path. The old separate crescent crossed the dome outline, which is the exact join the blob rule forbids.

comet.readsAs: The only asymmetric kin, and the only one whose signature is longer than its body. Torso sits forward of centre to balance the tail.
comet.signature: A thick tail bulge sweeping back and up off the left shoulder, gold-tipped. It is widest where it leaves the body and tapers to the tip, so it flows out of the mass instead of being pinned to it.
comet._fix: Tail rebuilt as a tapered mass rooted deep in the shoulder; the old one was a constant-width sliver that read as a detached stick.

_separation_rationale: Width divided by height runs 0.7 (Ember) · 0.9 (Sprout) · 1.1 (Slime) · 1.2 (Wisp) · 1.4 (Comet) · 1.5 (Droplet). Monotonic, so no two kin share a silhouette envelope. This is the property that makes the set legible at the 52pt art size the shop picks row uses — the top feature only confirms what the outline already said. If you adjust any geometry, preserve the ordering.
